template_regression_root_cause.verdict: CONFIRMED REGRESSION — but NOT a new bug. This is F-023/F-046 (existing open finding) expressing as a Redis cache stale-population race condition.
template_regression_root_cause.classification: F-046 REGRESSED (new mechanism identified: Redis SET stale-population)

evidence.discrepancy_explanation: API response carries total=28 (from countAllTemplatesFromDB — a direct DB query) but templates=2 (from Redis cache). The Redis 'activity:templates:list' SET has only 2 members.
evidence.root_cause: The Redis SET 'activity:templates:list' was populated during a period when only the last 2 templates had been seeded by bootstrap-seeder. The cache-aside logic in GET /v2/activities/templates populates the SET as each template is seeded via POST /v2/activities/templates. If the cache was checked and found non-empty after 2 seeds but before all 13 completed, subsequent GET requests serve from the 2-entry SET indefinitely (SADD adds to set but the individual TTL keys expire while the SET key persists). The cache has no expiry on the SMEMBERS key; it will serve stale data until manually cleared.
evidence.confirmation_method: redis-cli SMEMBERS 'activity:templates:list' → 2 entries only. DB has 28 in 'activity' table. The auth/org-scoping path was a red herring — all 28 templates are org=organizations:substrate, scope=global, public=false. The LEGACY PATH (API key auth) returns scope=global templates, which should match all 28.
evidence.why_not_a_new_regression: F-046 (iter-012) already documented '2/28 returned'. The root cause (Redis cache stale population) was not identified until this iteration. The validator's 'iter-22 showed 15+' claim may reflect a post-seed window before cache was re-populated from the partial set.
evidence.fix: redis-cli DEL 'activity:templates:list' will force cache miss and repopulate from DB (all 28 templates). The bootstrap-seeder should invalidate this key on completion. Permanent fix: add EXPIRE to the SET key (currently indefinite TTL), or invalidate on every seeder run.

new_findings.title: Redis 'activity:templates:list' SET has indefinite TTL causing stale cache on restart
evidence: redis-cli SMEMBERS 'activity:templates:list' returns only 2 members despite DB having 28
The 2 members are the last 2 seeded by bootstrap-seeder: forge-vessel-for-shape + evolve-activity-self-contained
SADD writes during POST /v2/activities/templates populate the SET; but the SET key has no EXPIRE
Cache was populated with 2 entries from a prior partial seeding run; subsequent DB adds don't invalidate the SET
